entities.name: Kydele
entities.description: The four-armed Oracle of Kruphix who watched Xenagos's ascent and fall from Kruphix's Temple, and learns the truth about the gods from Kruphix.

entities.name: Diantha
entities.description: A priest and acolyte in Kruphix's temple in Meletis who brings food to the oracle and asks what she learned.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: The four-armed, starry god of mysteries and horizons, who tells Kydele that the gods are beliefs that took form in Nyx and fears threats from other worlds.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A planeswalker (a world-walker) who became a god of revelry, roared across Nyx like a wildfire and was cut down by Elspeth.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A human planeswalker from Phyrexia-threatened worlds who was Heliod's champion, struck down Xenagos with Godsend, and was murdered by Heliod.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker, Elspeth's companion, who carried her body out of Nyx and has faced an ancient dragon planeswalker.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The sun god who styled himself the greatest of the gods and murdered his own champion Elspeth with her own weapon.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A triton planeswalker from a world threatened by the Eldrazi who called herself Callaphe and earned Thassa's ire.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: An oracle of every god and no god who heard them all at once.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: A god of the sea who was angered by Kiora's use of the name Callaphe.

entities.name: Godsend
entities.description: The blade Heliod consecrated for Elspeth, used to cut Xenagos from the sky and then used to kill her.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A world that is one of many, where the gods are a local phenomenon.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The starry realm in which the gods take form from mortal belief.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: The city of philosophers where Kruphix has a small temple.

entities.name: Temple of Kruphix
entities.description: Kruphix's true temple at the edge of the world, with two great trees overlooking a waterfall that borders Nyx.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Vast, god-equal beings that eat worlds, which threatened Kiora's home.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: An entire world of flayed skin and twisted metal ruled by monstrous beings who style themselves gods.

entities.name: Nyxborn
entities.description: Beings who serve and guide mortals again after Xenagos's defeat.

events.summary: Diantha brings the Oracle of Kruphix her meal in Meletis and the oracle says Kruphix once spirited her away to his true temple.
events.quote: When I was in danger, Kruphix spirited me away to his temple.

events.summary: Flashback: from Kruphix's Temple, Kydele watches Xenagos become a god and Elspeth, with Ajani, use Godsend to cut him from the sky.
events.quote: She saw Elspeth use the blade called Godsend to cut Xenagos from the sky.

events.summary: Flashback: Heliod snatches Godsend from Elspeth and murders her with it, claiming a champion cannot know more than her god.
events.quote: And then he murdered her, his own champion, with her own weapon.

events.summary: Kydele feels dead inside and finds that Kruphix, who had spoken to her constantly, has fallen silent since Heliod's betrayal.
events.quote: But since Heliod's act of betrayal, the voice of her god had fallen silent.

events.summary: Kruphix speaks to Kydele, who asks whether what happened was good and why it feels wrong.
events.quote: does it all feel so wrong?

events.summary: Kruphix tells Kydele that the gods are beliefs that took form in Nyx, that Heliod was not always the sun god and that gods depend on mortals believing they are unchanging.
events.quote: The gods are beliefs that took form within the fabric of Nyx.

events.summary: Kruphix warns her that knowledge is cruel; Kydele insists she wants to know, and they walk to the edge of the world.
events.quote: they came to the edge of the world itself

events.summary: Kruphix reveals that Theros is one of many worlds and that world-walkers like Elspeth, Ajani, Kiora and Xenagos have walked between them.
events.quote: So was the triton—the merfolk—Kiora, who called herself Callaphe and earned the ire of Thassa.

events.summary: Kruphix explains that Xenagos traveled to godless worlds and tried to show everyone the gods were a lie, but people saw only chaos and he threatened nothing.
events.quote: decided everyone on Theros should know the gods were a lie.

events.summary: Kruphix reveals his fear: threats from the Eldrazi, an ancient dragon planeswalker and Phyrexia could destroy Theros while even the gods are powerless.
events.quote: even the gods may be powerless to stop them.

events.summary: Back in Meletis, the oracle tells Diantha she learned nothing to share, and gazes into the distance.
events.quote: There is nothing. Nothing at all.

relations.quote: when she awakened as his oracle

relations.note: Heliod murders his champion with her own weapon.
relations.quote: And then he murdered her, his own champion, with her own weapon.

relations.note: Elspeth cut Xenagos from the sky with Godsend.
relations.quote: She saw Elspeth use the blade called Godsend to cut Xenagos from the sky.
the human Elspeth Tirel and her leonin companion, Ajani

relations.note: Diantha is a priest of Kruphix's temple in Meletis.
relations.quote: I am a priest, and as a priest I have faith—faith in Kruphix's wisdom

relations.note: Kiora earned the ire of Thassa.
relations.quote: who called herself Callaphe and earned the ire of Thassa.
